input.title: Gate new Gemini Flash prompt guidance behind an experiment (Flash 3.6/3.7)
input.body:
## Summary

The Gemini team provided three new prompt instructions to trial with Gemini Flash. This PR puts them behind an experiment-based setting so we can measure their impact on the metrics, scoped to **Gemini Flash 3.6 and 3.7** only.

The three additions in `DefaultGeminiAgentPrompt`:
- **Instructions section** — "Read ast/definitions first": prioritize reading config files / directory listings before blindly searching source files.
- **toolUseInstructions section** — "Tool Batching": chain multiple terminal steps into a single command.
- **toolUseInstructions section** — "Search Precision": refine `grep_search` patterns to target exact definitions instead of broad, high-volume searches.
